Lines.Text: A thin shaft of morning sunlight slipped through the practice room's narrow window.
But the room held none of morning's promise.
The vivid red [SEIZED] notices filled it with a violent, suffocating despair.
(turning the invitation over, frowning) What is this? Some kind of prank, P? It's painfully childish.
(rubbing his haggard face) Do I look like I'm in any state to pull a prank...?
Neither the dorm door nor my office door was opened. There's no sign anyone came in.
(holding the corner between two fingers, trembling) J-Jiwoo... I don't think we should touch this...
Doesn't the writing look like real blood...? It smells strange, too...
(holding her invitation up to the sunlight) It's okay, Hana! The design's really pretty, though.
It looks like an invitation from fairies. Do you think someone's secretly filming us for a prank show?
Jiwoo, seriously? A prank show, after every— Ah!
As Ria examined the invitation, she tripped over her own feet and dropped it.
(fumbling to pick it up) Anyway... P. Could S-Tier have sent someone to make absolutely sure we're finished?
(trying to soothe them, his voice gentle) ...Whoever sent them, it's just a cruel joke. Don't worry about it.
We have a bigger problem. The creditors are coming this afternoon to take everything that's left. It isn't safe for you to stay here.
Then what do we do? We won't even have anywhere to practice.
Go back to the dorm for now. I'll... I'll work something out.
Beg some old contacts. Take construction jobs. Whatever it takes to get the debt under control.
Just promise me you won't give up. Okay?
Huh? Hey. Look at the mirror.
Everyone turned toward the huge mirror where they practiced. It, too, was disfigured by red seizure notices.
But among those dozens of red stickers...
One sheet of paper, right in the center, radiated an alien violet glow.
What...? That wasn't there when we came in.
(rubbing her eyes, startled) P... I think that paper's glowing...?
(shouting as dread washes over him) Seoyun, don't touch it! It's dangerous!
Despite his warning, she stopped before the mirror and peeled the violet sheet from among the red stickers without hesitation.
CRACK—!
The instant the paper came free...
Black and red ink churned across the sheet as if boiling.
Then thousands of glyphs burst from the paper like a swarm of living insects.
(screaming, collapsing to the floor) Aaaah! Jiwoo!!
(pulling Hana tight, squeezing her eyes shut) Hana! Hold on to me!
(clutching her hair as it whips in the storm) What the hell is happening?! The letters... They're alive!
The vortex of glyphs tore the red seizure notices to shreds.
Then a blinding pillar of violet light erupted from the sheet in Seoyun's hand, spearing toward the ceiling.
(bracing himself against the floor, fighting the wind) Girls! Hold hands! Don't let go of each other!
(frantically grabbing Mina's and Jiwoo's hands, screaming) P! The floor... The floor's disappearing!
Violet fog and dancing blood-red glyphs engulfed them. Beyond the mirror, the Abyss opened its enormous maw.
FLASH—!!
In a burst of light, P and the five girls were sucked through the dimensional breach before they could scream.
In the empty basement, only shattered glass and a faint, unnatural scent of ink remained to prove they had ever been there.
